paragraphs: Rabbi Tzadok (Hyman reports Dikdukei Soferim’s reading R' Yitzchak) bar Chaluka: Yoma 78a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 78a reads רבי צדוק בן חקולא, Rabbi Tzadok ben Chakula. Hyman has bar Chaluka and reports Dikdukei Soferim’s Rabbi Yitzchak reading.

The named William Davidson Yoma 78a paragraph explicitly writes Rabbi Tzadok ben Chakula; his full title has local support. Hyman’s bar Chaluka form is retained separately. The Dikdukei Soferim reading is Hyman’s report, not a fresh collation, and its abbreviated title remains R' in the new body. The existing note remains unchanged. No father-name harmonization, identity binding or additional legal material is introduced.
